members.name: volume_breakout_v1
members.thesis: A volume breakout occurs when volume on a single bar exceeds 5x its 20-bar SMA AND price simultaneously breaks to a new session high/low. The extreme volume signals that a large participant (institution, algo) is aggressively entering the market. Unlike price-only breakouts (which fail ~60% of the t
entry_long: high > session_high[t-1] (new session high on the vol spike bar)
(close - low) / (high - low) > 0.7 (closed near high of bar)
entry_short: low < session_low[t-1] (new session low on the vol spike bar)
(high - close) / (high - low) > 0.7 (closed near low of bar)
members.exit_stop: VWAP OR 0.25% from entry, whichever is tighter
filters: no entries before 09:30 or after 14:00 (need time for follow-through)
5x is the core filter — extremely strict, by design
weaknesses: 5x volume spikes are rare — may see 0-2 qualifying signals per day across the entire NIFTY 200 universe
Some 5x volume spikes are caused by block deals or basket trades at market midpoint — no directional information
The confirmation bar requirement means entering after a large-volume bar, where slippage may be higher than normal 3 bps

members.name: volume_breakout_v1
members.thesis: This strategy trades high-volume breakouts. It enters when price breaks a recent high/low accompanied by volume significantly above normal. The inefficiency is that volume surges often precede sustained moves, but many traders focus only on price. It persists because interpreting volume is subjectiv
weaknesses: High false-breakout rate on volatile days
Volume surge may be due to news that later reverses
Range breakouts may be subject to pinch outs after initial move

members.name: volume_profile_breakout_v1
members.thesis: Price consolidates at high-volume nodes (HVN) where many participants have transacted. When price breaks away from an HVN with above-average volume, trapped traders (who bought/sold at the HVN) are forced to exit, creating follow-through. The inefficiency exists because HVN/LVN analysis requires rea
members.exit_stop: poc (for longs) or poc (for shorts) — i.e., back into value area
filters: no entry in first 30 min (let profile develop) or last 30 min
prefer breakouts in direction of index trend (nifty EMA(21) slope)
weaknesses: Volume profile is computationally intensive to update in real-time and the POC/VA boundaries shift throughout the day, creating moving targets.
Early in the session (<30 min), the profile is unreliable — insufficient data. Waiting for 30+ min of data means missing morning breakouts.
False breakouts from value area are common — 55-60% of breakouts reverse. The volume confirmation helps but doesn't solve the problem entirely.
members.prior_art: Market Profile / Volume Profile analysis. James Dalton's 'Markets in Profile'. TPO-based analysis adapted to volume-at-price.
